title: Indonesian police say lab analysis found six accounts that carried out cyberattacks on the government in a treason case
date_note: Police statement at a press conference on Tuesday 24 November 2026, as dated by Beritasatu; the date of the attacks is not given.
geo_basis: Police statement made at Mabes Polri, Jakarta, per Beritasatu.
summary: Brigjen Pol Susatyo Purnomo Condro, director of general criminal acts at Bareskrim Polri, said on 24 November that lab analysis of phones seized in the treason (makar) case found six accounts that carried out cyberattacks on the government. Kumparan quotes him as saying at least 6 accounts. Police are still investigating and he did not rule out new suspects.
plain: Indonesian police say that phones seized in a treason case contained six accounts that carried out cyberattacks on the government. Police are still investigating.
exec: Police in Indonesia say six accounts found in a treason case attacked the government; the inquiry continues.

setidaknya terdapat 6 akun yang melakukan serangan secara siber kepada pemerintah.

validation.note: Beritasatu and Kumparan, two publishers, each report Bareskrim's statement of 24 November that six accounts were found. Police's own release not read; the pages read do not describe the attacks.
